text: Three new preprints from the lab on RL for LLMs are on arXiv: selector-guided RLVR curricula, adversarial robustness of empathetic agents, and adaptive negative reinforcement.
“Spatially-Infused Spectrograms for Robust EEG Feature Extraction in Deep Learning Frameworks” appears in ICASSP 2026.
Joined the Department of Artificial Intelligence, SVNIT Surat as Assistant Professor.
Validation of the Neuphony 8-channel EEG flex cap published in Frontiers in Neuroscience.
